name: Update tier per format
prose: an NSIS install and a writable AppImage self-update; the portable `.exe`, the `.dmg`, the `.deb` and the `.tar.gz` open their own asset in the browser. A read-only AppImage moves to the assisted tier instead of failing.
invariant: Install format decides the update tier for the life of the install, and Windows portable is detected by PORTABLE_EXECUTABLE_DIR, never by platform.
